behavior: canonical renderer and audio generate/store unchanged pixels first; gamma is applied to canonical RGB then the user brightness is applied as a final output-only scale; zero is black and 255 is identity; nonzero output keeps any nonzero canonical pixel participating despite channel quantization
source_semantics: Gamma is applied to each completed canonical pixel, then its final Matrix-only output scale is applied. The renderer writes canonicalMatrixPixels before this output stage. AUX transport brightness is untouched.
performance_correction: GCC always_inline on scaleChannel and scaleOutputPixel preserves exact channel math and fallback semantics while removing the three per-channel out-of-line calls visible in the R3 Xtensa object under -Os.
